sources.title: Wikipedia: Bill Clinton
sources.description: President of the United States from 1993 to 2001

notes.text: William Jefferson Bill Clinton is an American former politician and lawyer who served as the 42nd president of the United States from 1993 to 2001.
Bill Clinton's centrist "Third Way" political philosophy became known as Clintonism, which dominated his presidency and the succeeding decades of Democratic Party history.
Bill Clinton is remembered as a politician connected with United States.
Bill Clinton's recorded life dates place this profile around born 1946.
Bill Clinton is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
